detailed_descriptions.en: This game is developed entirely by human creators and does not contain any contents or assets generated by AI tools. HARMA is a retro dark fantasy roguelike deckbuilding game featuring a story-driven campaign. A Grim Tale of Fate The knights who returned from their expedition began slaughtering their own people. On the day the kingdom burned and everything was lost, you were left standing alone in the heart of the tragedy. In a world filled with betrayal and despair, uncover the truth and stand against the darkness. Unique and Strategic Battles through the Artifact System In Harma’s battles, the power of your cards is determined randomly based on the activation of three artifacts. However, you can spend Focus to forcefully activate artifacts and take control of fate. Will you leave it to chance, or will you risk it all with decisive focus? Your choice will completely alter the battlefield. Combine two playable characters with over 300 unique cards and artifacts to forge your own deck and strategy. Campaign Harma’s campaign unfolds across four epic acts. Experience the fall of the world and the fate of Eden firsthand through dynamic battles, branching dialogues, and cinematic cutscenes. Dimensional Rift If you seek pure combat and strategy beyond the story, challenge yourself in the Dimensional Rift mode. In this endlessly replayable mode, you will face relentless battles without cinematic storytelling. Take on ever-changing challenges and push your limits to the extreme.

detailed_descriptions_html.en:
This game is developed entirely by human creators and does not contain any contents or assets generated by AI tools.

HARMA is a retro dark fantasy roguelike deckbuilding game featuring a story-driven campaign.

A Grim Tale of Fate

The knights who returned from their expedition began slaughtering their own people.

On the day the kingdom burned and everything was lost, you were left standing alone in the heart of the tragedy.

In a world filled with betrayal and despair, uncover the truth and stand against the darkness.

Unique and Strategic Battles through the Artifact System

In Harma’s battles, the power of your cards is determined randomly based on the activation of three artifacts.

However, you can spend Focus to forcefully activate artifacts and take control of fate.

Will you leave it to chance, or will you risk it all with decisive focus?

Your choice will completely alter the battlefield.

Combine two playable characters with over 300 unique cards and artifacts to forge your own deck and strategy.

Campaign

Harma’s campaign unfolds across four epic acts.

Experience the fall of the world and the fate of Eden firsthand through dynamic battles, branching dialogues, and cinematic cutscenes.

Dimensional Rift

If you seek pure combat and strategy beyond the story, challenge yourself in the Dimensional Rift mode.

In this endlessly replayable mode, you will face relentless battles without cinematic storytelling.

Take on ever-changing challenges and push your limits to the extreme.
